system.description:
You may treat Talents from the Lightsaber Combat Talent Tree as Force Talents. Additionally, the Vibroshield satisfies the requirement for an activated Lightsaber for any Force Talent or Force Power.

If you create your own Vibroshield (see Build Object), you are considered to be behind Improved Cover instead of Cover when using the Fight Defensively Action.

holocron.sourceBook: Clone Wars Saga Edition Fan Sourcebook - Force Users
